goal: Fix Task 4 round 2 test contracts so node-ID tie ordering and bounded lazy candidate generation are genuinely observable through pure reusable implementation seams.
non_goals: No AI, chat, credential, persistence, dependency, packaging or release changes.
acceptance_criteria: A test observes a deterministic node-ID tie contract whose result changes without implementation ID sorting.
A test exercises the real candidate iterator/search path and fails on eager generation beyond the configured or default cap.
Free original positions succeed and vertical ingest batches use a six-screen-pixel gap.
Rigid copy preserves relative geometry, uses 32-screen-pixel repeated offsets and rejects overlapping sources.
Search order is deterministic: up, right, down, left, then node ID.
Default limits are 2400 screen pixels and 4096 candidates.
Resource failures compact and the 28px diagonal cascade is eliminated.
Focused, canvas, TypeScript, diff, L2 and independent review gates pass.
notes: Do not read or print provider credentials.
